csv_project_name: GC/CM for Chief Joseph Dam Upstream Fish Passage
csv_scope_of_work: The UCUT P2IP Committee is seeking a highly qualified, customer-focused GC/CM firm to participate as a critical, integrated team member throughout design, preconstruction and construction. The successful GC/CM will demonstrate highly effective pre construction services including early scope development, phasing recommendations, estimating, constructability reviews, value engineering recommendations and risk management. A critical component of P2IP involves the design, construction, and commissioning of interim upstream fish passage facility at Chief Joseph Dam, which is the most downstream dam that fully blocks salmon passage. Construction of such facilities comprises the Project for which this solicitation seeks General Contractor/Construction Manager services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
